Quote checklist

Send these details before asking for a CMN rate.

For oversized air cargo, a low quote without these details is usually not a real solution. This checklist helps us judge whether the cargo can be loaded, transferred, cleared and delivered.

Commodity and clear cargo description
HS Code and declared customs value
Length x width x height for every package
Gross weight and chargeable weight check
Packing photos, crate material and forklift access
Lifting points, center of gravity and loading direction
Origin city in China and cargo ready date
Final city, site address or airport pickup plan
Latest required arrival date and urgency reason

FAQ

Common questions about China to CMN air freight.

Can oversized cargo fly from China to CMN Casablanca?

It depends on package dimensions, gross weight, lifting points, aircraft availability and destination handling at CMN. For large pieces, we first check loading feasibility before discussing the airfreight rate.

When should LGG/BRU Europe transit be considered for CMN?

LGG/BRU should be considered when China direct flights cannot accept the cargo size, weight or timing. Europe transit can create a workable second-leg option for Africa project cargo, but it must be checked case by case.

What documents are needed before quoting China to CMN air freight?

Send commodity, HS Code, invoice value, packing list, dimensions, gross weight, packing photos, lifting points, origin city, destination city and latest arrival requirement. Regulated goods may need extra permits.

Is CMN suitable for mining or engineering project cargo?

Best for Morocco automotive, manufacturing, industrial and time-sensitive trade cargo. The key is not only airport-to-airport freight, but whether customs, handling and inland delivery can support the project schedule.
